page0.text:
...I remember.
Before, Rider asked me a question under the stars.
She wanted to know whether I would be on Sakura's side until the very end, no matter what.

page1.text:
I couldn't answer back then.
But now, I can say it with pride.

page2.text:
"Rider. I know Sakura is important to you.
Even now, you're here to stop me from leaving because it would make Sakura suffer."

page3.text:
"...Yes. Are you going to go kill Sakura despite that, Shirou?"
"I'm not going to kill her. I'm going to save her.
Rider, I'll protect Sakura until the very end. No matter what happens, I will always choose her."

page4.text: "But to do that...I need your help. Tohsaka and I can't save her alone. If you really care about Sakura, then please help me, just this once."

page5.text:
"Is that...
...your answer to the question I asked before?"
I nod silently.

page6.text:
"...Very well.
But I will not participate in a battle with no chance of victory. What do you expect me to do, Shirou?"

page7.text:
What I expect Rider to do?
There's only one thing.
Out of all the Servants in this war, Rider is the only one with a Noble Phantasm that can resist Saber's Noble Phantasm which is Sakura's most powerful card.

page8.text:
"I have a question for you first. Can you use your Noble Phantasm right now?"
"Yes. Sakura still provides me with magical energy."

page9.text: "Next question: Servants are classified as spiritual bodies even when you're in material form, right? If so, is it true that normal weapons can't harm a Servant?"

page10.text:
"...I would say that a normal Servant would render such attacks ineffective, but it is different for the Servants under Sakura's thrall.
Saber is a being given flesh, who cannot return to spirit form.
A powerful magical implement could pierce the black armor that protects them."

page11.text:
"...I see. Then that settles it. We have a chance, and I know exactly what you can do to help.
Rider, I want you to beat Saber one-on-one. To be specific..."

page12.text:
I whisper in Rider's ear.
...It's not like anyone's listening to us, but I'm just being safe.

page13.text:
"...I see. That would allow us to break through.
It is a contest of brute force, at any rate. We don't need to worry about complications."
"Right? If there is a problem, it would be..."

page14.text: "Your skills, and how much I can trust them."
